explication: OSS Rebuild reproduces selected upstream open-source package builds and publishes attestations that can be checked against upstream artifacts. The main user path is package/version lookup through the CLI or dashboard to stored rebuild and attestation data; the service API also exposes rebuild and inference operations. Ecosystem-specific rebuilders cover npm, PyPI, and Crates.io, while the README documents successful attestation publication and verification. Additional branches include automated analysis, an AI-assisted agent, and snapshot-backed dashboard reads. Some service internals were not sampled, so those subsystem links are documented or omitted rather than inferred.
